notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found. The Jack's Creek = Cabo link is inferred (same county, same era of state records), not stated by any source; check the state's Cabo waypoint (CST001) to confirm. The Register's 2023 visit says the site is privately owned, while its administrator line still names TDF; the story follows the ownership note. The record's agency field is out of date (see corrections). Forest Lookouts' Chester page in the cache is Chester County, South Carolina, so it was not used. Re-check the site after 2023 for demolition or access changes.
